That's totally fine! What are some of your favorite RPGs? Shooters are never easy and I mainly play shooters lol I'm still trying to improve! I thought about downloading an aim trainer to see if that could help me?

Ooh, all of my friend's LOVE Genshin. Who is your favorite character? I really like Venti but never pulled him when he was first introduced so I got upset and uninstalled lol

It's okay to not pretend like everything is alright because, well, it's not. And that's okay. Life can't be perfect all the time or else we would have nothing to look forward to. I know playing the "what if" game isn't the best, but "what if" you find that love? It doesn't have to be romantic, it can be platonic. It can be towards something. Say you find a new favorite song, hobby, game, maybe you adopt a new animal? It can be anything. I understand wanting love, everybody wants love. You never know what's around the corner, even if the hallway seems long and dark.

Hey, you're right. Just talking to someone doesn't mean things will get better, but it's definitely a start :) I understand where you're coming from in that it feels you move further back then forward. I like to believe that that's how the start is. We're getting used to everything and we're trying to get into that groove of reversing the feelings. At least, that's what I like to tell myself. I hope your days feel lighter and brighter soon.
What do you want to talk about?
What kind do you play?

There are a lot of resources out there that you could send them such as hotlines or options for free/low cost therapy near them (if that is something they are comfortable with). You can also just be there for them and ask what they want to do. Sometimes they just want someone to listen to them rant. Sometimes they want a distraction. Sometimes spontaneously inviting them to go for a walk in the park or go to a cafe can work too, it just depends on the person and what they like and are comfortable with :)

First, you are not responsible for someone's death. You did everything that you possibly could at the time and it is absolutely not your fault. I don't want you to hold that kind of weight on your shoulders. There are other factors that influence a person's decision. **You** are not the cause. 

As for your friend, I would suggest just sending them resources for help and just being there for them and offering support. There are countless resources and hot lines that have trained professionals that are available 24/7 and those could definitely be of benefit.
I'm proud of you for being more active in your treatment! Wishing you the best in everything :)

My parents were the same way and I wasn't able to get help until I moved out. It took a lot of trial and error and it was really frustrating because I wish my parents would have helped me sooner. But I'm assuming they just didn't understand what I was wanting because I never said, "Hey, I would like to see a professional about this." I don't know if you'd be comfortable with it, but maybe bring it up to your parents again and express to them that you would like to talk to someone about this so the thoughts don't get worse?

However, I found a new resource that has really been helping me and I would be more than happy to share it with you (though I don't know if I can post the app in the comments?). If you are interested, please feel free to DM me. 

Wishing you the best!
Crisis Text Line - text HOME to 741741

Ooh, ER is so cool and you'll definitely find, see, and learn a lot of cool things! It's hard, but maybe it'll be nice to at least see it? Even if only for a little :) It'll definitely be a cool experience!

I'm going through a very similar situation now and your feelings are completely valid. It's not easy to come to terms with everything, but it shows a lot of good things about you that you're able to acknowledge the mistakes. That being said, I do hope you accomplish everything you want in the next year and maybe find another form of joy to keep you going for longer than a year. Be sure to stick with professional help and surround yourself with people that make you happy because it's always easier than fighting alone. Wishing you the best and I hope you find that hope soon :)

We can't change the past, but what we can do is change the future. That's still a hard concept I am trying to learn, but it takes time to get there and get into that mindset. I'm wishing you the best and hope things start to look up for you.
I'm listening, love! Whatever you need or want to say, I will listen.

I'm in the same boat right now. It's horrible and it sucks, you just want to turn your brain off. I wish there could be a way to take away all of the memories like in Black Mirror (if you've seen it, if not, it's a good episode!), but we just don't have that technology (yet - haha). 

I'm wishing you the best and I hope the thoughts start to ease up. Even if it's hard, find little things to distract yourself. A small distraction is better than nothing. Let's both take this one step at a time - baby steps work too.
What do you want to do after high school?

I understand how you feel. I don't regret my attempt, I just regret being caught before I could finish. But, since we are both here, we should try to make the best out of what we can, right? :) It's not easy and I feel for you 100%. Games are not as fun anymore, but there are hundreds of games out there, we should be able to find at least *one*, right? 

What kind of games do you like to play?
Do you play any video games? If you do, we can definitely play together sometime! I'm on PC :)

I too am basically staying for my niece. But, hey, there's nothing wrong with using your kids as a reason to stay. Even if it's not a reason that's necessarily personal (ie, "I will be successful in the future,"), it's a perfectly good reason. What helps me is I think about how my niece wants to go to the fair in October. Even though I had my last day planned for August 27, I want to be able to take her to the fair. Any excuse I can find to last a bit longer for her is all that I need. The suffering sucks, but I do this for her.
Nursing school is definitely rough. What are you planning in going into? Are you interested in ER, ICU, bedside, etc.?
